_comment: Reference manifest for osmeng-agent-starter. install.sh has this logic baked in directly (no JSON parser dependency) — edit both files together if you add a source.

core.name: taste-skill
core.note: Design-taste / anti-slop skills (brandkit, brutalist, minimalist, redesign, image-to-code, etc.)

core.name: ponytail
core.note: Minimal-diff / 'laziest senior dev' coding discipline. Also mirrored under .openclaw/skills — installer only reads skills/.

core.name: claude-seo (core)
core.note: Technical SEO / schema / GEO / content skills that need no paid API key. 8 more skills live under extensions/<provider>/skills/ (Ahrefs, SE Ranking, DataForSEO, Bing Webmaster, Profound, Firecrawl, unlighthouse, banana image-gen) — those need that provider's API key, so the installer skips them; add manually if you have the accounts.

core.name: obsidian-skills
core.note: Obsidian CLI, Bases, JSON Canvas, Markdown, defuddle. Needs Obsidian running for the CLI parts.

core.name: mattpocock/skills
core.note: Nested by category: skills/<engineering|productivity|misc|in-progress>/<name>/SKILL.md. Installer flattens and prefixes as '<category>-<name>' to avoid collisions.

requested_addons.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
requested_addons.note: Google's Chrome DevTools MCP + 6 skills (a11y/LCP/memory). Also an npm MCP server: npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest. Requires Chrome + Node LTS.

requested_addons.name: gh-cli-skills
requested_addons.note: GitHub CLI官方 skills: 'gh' (patterns for invoking gh from agents) + 'gh-skill' (skill lifecycle). Also requires the gh binary itself: https://cli.github.com/  — winget install GitHub.cli on Windows, brew install gh on macOS.

requested_addons.name: context7
requested_addons.note: Up-to-date library docs. Install via: npx ctx7 setup --opencode  (auto-wires) OR add OpenCode plugin '@upstash/context7-opencode' OR add remote MCP https://mcp.context7.com/mcp. CLI package is 'ctx7' (ctx7 docs <libId> <query>).

requested_addons.name: agent-swarm (swarm-spawner)
requested_addons.note: This is the repo behind https://mcpmarket.com/tools/skills/agent-swarm-spawner (mcpmarket listing points to github.com/c-daly/agent-swarm). 19 skills for spawning subagent swarms with role-based routing, phase gates, context isolation. Claude Code install: 'claude plugin install agent-swarm'. For OpenCode: skills are copied and work directly; no MCP required (MCP is the in-plugin router).

requested_addons.name: superpowers
requested_addons.note: Obra's 14 workflow skills (TDD/dispatch/plan/debug) + OpenCode plugin. OpenCode native install is a plugin: "superpowers@git+https://github.com/obra/superpowers.git" in opencode.json -> plugin[]. Skills are also copied for file-based fallback; plugin and file copy coexist.

mcp_only.name: mcp-supersubagents
mcp_only.note: Pure MCP server (no SKILL.md). Spawns parallel autonomous agents via Codex/Copilot/Claude backends with task dependencies, auto-rotation, templates (coder/planner/researcher/tester). Requires Node 18+. No skill copy needed — just add the MCP entry.

mega_opt_in.name: ECC
mega_opt_in.note: Huge general-purpose skill library (languages, frameworks, security, healthcare compliance, logistics, finance, agent-harness patterns...). Repo also mirrors the same skills under .cursor/, .kiro/, .agents/, and localized docs/<lang>/ trees — installer only reads the canonical top-level skills/. Cherry-picking individual folders is usually more useful than installing all 286.

mega_opt_in.name: OmniRoute
mega_opt_in.note: Skills for driving OmniRoute itself (an AI gateway: one endpoint, 350+ model providers). Only useful if you actually deploy OmniRoute.

documented_not_installed.name: ruflo
documented_not_installed.why: Full agent meta-harness/orchestration framework (swarm coordination, AgentDB, etc.), not a plain skill pack. 350+ SKILL.md files live inside its own plugins/<plugin>/skills/ system and depend on the ruflo runtime being installed — copying the folders alone won't work. Has its own installer; see the repo README.

documented_not_installed.name: claude-mem
documented_not_installed.why: Persistent cross-session memory plugin. Its ~20 skills (mem-search, timeline-report, standup, etc.) operate on data captured by claude-mem's own hook/backend, so they need the real plugin installed, not just the SKILL.md folders. See the repo README.

documented_not_installed.name: headroom
documented_not_installed.why: Token-compression proxy/library/MCP server for tool output — a running service, not a skill at all.

documented_not_installed.name: awesome-design-md
documented_not_installed.why: A collection of DESIGN.md reference files meant to be dropped straight into a project root so a coding agent picks up brand/design conventions from context — not the SKILL.md format, so it isn't something 'installed' as a skill.

companion_clis.why: Tools skills can shell out to. Install via each project's own documented method (not npm -g in Supabase's case) — see repo README.
CLI wrapper for recording/generating Playwright code.

companion_clis.name: gh CLI
companion_clis.install: winget install --id GitHub.cli  |  brew install gh

companion_clis.name: ctx7 CLI
companion_clis.install: npm i -g ctx7  or  npx ctx7@latest setup --opencode

not_applicable.why: Local desktop app for image-to-3D-model generation — unrelated to coding agents/skills.
